business_summary: Kunshan Huguang Auto Harness Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of wiring harnesses for passenger vehicles in China. The company offers complete wiring harnesses, engine wiring harnesses, and other wiring harnesses, customized wiring harnesses for complete vehicles, high-voltage wiring harnesses for new energy vehicles, battery pack wiring harnesses, engine wiring harnesses, instrument panel wiring harnesses, body wiring harnesses, door wiring harnesses, headliner wiring harnesses, and rear wiring harnesses. The company serves Volkswagen, Daimler-Benz, Audi, General Motors, Jaguar Land Rover, Seres, L Automotive , T Company , NIO , Geely Jike, Chery Automobile, and FAW Hongqi automobile manufacturers. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Kunshan, China.
